subject.title: fix: pin repair review base and refresh credentials before post-flight publication

question: Should post-flight GitHub publication move to a separate short-lived workflow step, or should the long-running executor refresh its credential immediately before publication?
rationale: The functional repair is well-defined, but repository policy requires explicit maintainer intent for changes to credential lifetime and deterministic mutation boundaries.

options.title: Separate post-flight step
options.body: Persist and upload the result first, then mint a fresh least-privilege token in a short workflow step for publication and automerge continuation.

options.title: Refresh inside executor
options.body: Reissue a scoped token immediately before post-flight calls and prove that all Codex subprocess environments continue to strip it.

recommendation.title: Separate post-flight step
recommendation.body: Persist and upload the result first, then mint a fresh least-privilege token in a short workflow step for publication and automerge continuation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the affected executor and workflow credential boundary and is the strongest history-based owner for this choice.
